tasks.short: Maintain office hours for student advice and assistance.

steps.what: Maintain and check actual office-hour availability in the existing calendar
Save the checked final office-hour calendar entry
Maintain regularly scheduled office hours to advise and assist actual students

tasks.design: Keep actual office-hour advice with the teacher and retain the existing native schedule in {CALENDAR}. The occasional calendar edit and save are split out; no repeated manual process has been established that a new tool removes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Office-hour value comes from actual student assistance rather than schedule entry.
tasks.enabler_now: The existing calendar already supports the small scheduling transaction.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding student misconceptions and providing useful assistance require conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher responds to the student's actual reasoning.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native calendars already support office-hour availability; maintaining a schedule does not replace actual student advice.

assumptions: Calendar preparation is occasional and counted once per actual schedule change, not per office-hour session. Shares are a provisional combined task mix, not a measured baseline; if no edit occurs, reweight assistance to 100.

The actual calendar write and save are explicitly separated and fully retained. No additional student note, report or digital send is required by the task; any real required student record belongs once in task 5918.
Existing native calendar functionality supplies no new saving. The save uses the existing final entry check without additional self-approval work.
No new software is introduced, so no incremental upkeep arises.
unknowns: Is any scheduling work actually duplicated?
research_questions: Confirm actual calendar maintenance before proposing a change.

incremental.description: No new calendar tool or configuration; no new upkeep.

approvals.approved_version: s1 checked final office-hour calendar entry and exact calendar destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All advising and the occasional native calendar transaction remain retained; no new saving or upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise student teaching, internships and research.

steps.what: Retrieve actual student teaching, internship or research work and supervision requirements
Supervise undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship and research work
outputs: actual supervision findings and chosen feedback

steps.what: Write and check actual supervisory feedback on the student's work
inputs: actual supervision findings and chosen feedback

loop.purpose: Draft written supervision feedback from actual teacher findings
loop.input: Actual work, chosen feedback and supervision findings
loop.check: Teacher checks scientific and pedagogical meaning, omitted uncertainty and unsupported criticism or praise
loop.stop: Missing actual teacher feedback or two failed revisions returns writing to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Native comment headings and source links first; feedback explanations vary

steps.what: Deliver the checked final supervisory feedback to the actual student

tasks.design: Configure native supervision-source links in {LMS} and fixed feedback headings before bounded drafting in {DOCS}. The teacher supervises actual work, chooses the feedback, checks its final meaning and separately delivers it to the student.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision can repeat source navigation and written explanation of chosen feedback.
tasks.enabler_now: Native work links and bounded feedback drafting can reduce preparation and writing.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific progress, teaching quality and appropriate guidance require direct supervision.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises when an apparent result hides a conceptual or methodological problem.
tasks.altitude: Less supervision preparation and feedback prose; judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native work links and bounded feedback drafting can reduce navigation and prose preparation; they do not assess student work autonomously.

assumptions: Actual student supplies work and prior plan; teacher verifies relevance in s1, studies actual work and chooses feedback in s2, then captures and checks feedback meaning within retained s3. No free feedback-note producer is assumed.
Only actual written-feedback cases are eligible. Oral-only supervision omits s3/s4 and reweights; no new writing baseline is invented. No mark or automated student evaluation is introduced.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native source links/templates first; existing preparation earns zero saving. Routine delivery is one percent and gates the exact final comments and student destination.
Student record maintenance is handled once in task 5918 rather than counted again as feedback saving.
unknowns: How much supervision feedback is written?
research_questions: Does checked drafting reduce feedback writing without losing scientific or pedagogical meaning?

already_counted.description: Capture and correct actual feedback meaning within s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual supervision-source links and feedback checks.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual supervisory feedback and exact student work destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 navigation + 19*0.30 feedback prose = 9.7; minus 1 upkeep = 8.7. Half eligible gives 4.85 minus 1 = 3.85. Actual supervision, feedback decisions and delivery stay retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve actual course questions and discussion sources relevant to the physics topic
inputs: actual physics topic and course goals
actual existing question and source bank

steps.what: Initiate, facilitate and moderate actual classroom discussions

tasks.design: Configure native topic links to the existing question/source bank in {LMS} and {DOCS}. The teacher checks relevance and personally initiates and moderates the discussion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Discussion preparation can repeat source navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native topic/source links can shorten actual lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Productive questioning and responding to misconceptions require classroom judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher hears student reasoning and adjusts the discussion in real time.
tasks.altitude: Less source navigation; discussion stays fully human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native course/source links can support discussion preparation; they do not facilitate the actual classroom conversation.

assumptions: Actual question/source bank already exists; teacher verifies relevance in s1. New scientific questions or interpretations remain teacher work, with no free source creation.
Boundary is actual lookup and discussion. No separate record, report or send is specified; any required student record is counted once under task 5918.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Only actual repeated navigation is eligible; already linked sources earn zero saving. Material prepared once is not charged anew for each discussion.
unknowns: How much source navigation actually precedes discussions?
research_questions: Can native course links reduce repeated lookup without changing discussion time?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 navigation = 4; minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Half eligible gives 2 minus 0.5 = 1.5. All actual discussion stays retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain attendance, grades and other student records.

steps.what: Collect and verify actual attendance, assessed grades and other required record inputs
Transfer actual existing grades and attendance into draft student registry fields
Maintain student attendance records, grades and other required records in registry {OTHER}
Check final student records against actual attendance, assessed grades and required fields
outputs: checked final actual student registry records

steps.what: Commit the checked final actual student registry records
inputs: checked final actual student registry records
outputs: committed actual attendance, grades and required records

tasks.design: Configure supported native attendance/grade transfer from {LMS} into draft fields in the student registry {OTHER}, followed by native required-field entry. The teacher captures actual primary inputs, checks complete final records and commits them separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing grades and attendance may be re-entered into a separate registry.
tasks.enabler_now: Supported exact-field mapping can remove duplicate transfer and repeated references.
tasks.still_hard: Student identity, actual attendance, assessed grade and completeness require full checks.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher knows whether a grade or attendance value is the actual authorised result.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate records work; grade decisions remain human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supported native grade and attendance mappings can reduce duplicate registry entry where actual identifiers and result states match; local support is unverified.

assumptions: Actual teacher/attendance owner supplies student, course, assessment/event identifier, date, value and result status. Primary capture and verification are retained in s1; missing/ambiguous fields and new required notes remain manual in s3.

S2 is explicit draft transfer, not automated grading or publication. S3 cuts repeated identifiers and standard fields, retaining actual additional content capture. All final identity/grade checks remain in s4.
Native integration first; already automatic transfers earn zero saving. Shared records from advising or supervision are counted once here.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Routine commit retains one percent and uses the existing final record check. Any separate student-facing release requires its own actual final-version gate with no saving claimed.
unknowns: Which records are entered in both systems?
Does the registry support a native draft import?
research_questions: Does actual draft import reduce duplicate entry after full result and identity checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual course/student mappings and required registry fields.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual student registry records and exact student/course destinations; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 30 duplicate transfer + 25*0.40 repeated fields = 40; minus 2 upkeep = 38. Half eligible gives 20 minus 2 = 18. Primary capture, grade decisions, final checking and commit remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Physics teachers retain advice, supervision and discussion while actual repeated source access, feedback writing and registry entry may shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Validate duplicate record work and actual written feedback without adding office-hour administration.
